$description: OtpInput (platform/components/OtpInput), library wave 6, lane B: its component tokens. Each box is drawn with the input roles (the text field's), square at the prominent control height, the code in the data font.

otp-input-gap.$description: OtpInput: the space between two boxes.

otp-input-cell-width.$description: OtpInput box: its width (a square: the prominent control height).

otp-input-cell-height.$description: OtpInput box: its height (the prominent control height).

otp-input-cell-font-family.$description: OtpInput box: a code is a technical value, in the data font.

otp-input-cell-font-size.$description: OtpInput box: the character's size (the lead step, readable at a glance).

otp-input-cell-hover-border-color.$description: OtpInput box: the border under the pointer.

otp-input-cell-focus-border-color.$description: OtpInput box: the border of the box in focus (no ring outside it).

otp-input-cell-invalid-border-color.$description: OtpInput box: the border when the code is wrong, kept while focused.

otp-input-cell-disabled-background.$description: OtpInput box: the neutral fill when disabled.

otp-input-cell-disabled-text.$description: OtpInput box: the character's color when disabled.
